source: Byte-exact line-range cut of the site's prettified chunks (js-beautify). The served bundle splits three.js (vendor), the vinext/React runtime (vendor), the app's course/terrain module, and the ride page.
note: Vendor rule: three.js (engine chunk lines 1-33192) and the vinext framework runtime (index chunk + page chunk lines 1-5078) are indexed whole, not sliced. Slices cover only app code.

sections.title: three.js r1xx (bundled)
sections.desc: The whole three build plus app-tail-free addons, inside the engine chunk. Indexed whole: library code, not sliced. The app's own engine code starts at line 33193 (function Up).

sections.title: Sky, sun & ocean dressing
sections.desc: App-side sky rig on three's SkyShader: sunset/mist uniforms (Up), sun disc + glow quads (Wp), sky construction with patched fragment shader (Gp), ocean-swell GLSL (Kp), water surface (qp), sun lens flare (Jp).

sections.title: Spark trail particles
sections.desc: GPU spark-trail emitter (em): ring buffers of head/tail/fade/width attributes and the glow shader, with per-frame update().

sections.title: Game audio
sections.desc: Ambient audio engine (tm): menu/soundtrack tracks, wind filter node graph, user-gesture activation, dispose.

sections.title: RideEngine
sections.desc: Camera presets (nm) and the engine class (rm): scene/camera/renderer setup, terrain + sky wiring, rider state machine (ready/finished), HUD visibility, dispose. Exported as `RideEngine`.

sections.title: Course layout & sections
sections.desc: Course constants (mountain 2400 m, valley 4200 m, sprint 3260 m), the section list (Wild Pass, Forest Descent, Deep in the Forest, Golden Switchbacks, ...), feature bands (m: curve/lean gates), noise helpers and the smoothing spline (w/T/E).

sections.title: Terrain sampling
sections.desc: Section-aware falloff (_), easings, centreline rebuild into P[] (heading te, grade ne, perpendiculars), point lookup F, feature solvers (le) and the ridge shaping used by the road.

sections.title: Terrain GLSL & surface details
sections.desc: Ridge drop-off (B), height field H/V, coast-continuation GLSL chunk (fe), beach/sand blend he (K/q/J), and the detail-sampling helpers (ye/be/xe/Se).

sections.title: Scenery & prop placement
sections.desc: Deterministic prop spread over the course (Se cache, we/Te/Ee/De/Oe), section metadata ke (names/notes per section) and the tree/rock band generator (X/je/Ne/Pe).

sections.title: Rider physics
sections.desc: Friction constants (Fe), speed integrators (ze/Be/Q/Ve/He/Ue), rider state snapshot (We) and the main step function et: gravity/carve/recovery, off-course handling, section progress, finish.

sections.title: vinext framework runtime (bundled)
sections.desc: The page chunk's lines 1-5078: vinext client runtime, Base UI primitives, radix-style helpers, lucide icon table, and the shared `mountain`/`wind`/`play`/`rotate-ccw` icons. Library code, indexed whole via the engine-side vendor entry convention.

sections.title: Ride page UI
sections.desc: The page component (Go): start menu, section chooser, live HUD (speed/km/altitude), finish summary with km traveled, ride-again and section buttons.
